## Campus day

Two sessions a day with lunch between them, up to five teaching hours, six days a week.
A pen-and-paper recap paper of about two hours, AI-free, then a break, then the solution discussion led by the Academic TA.

## Cohort

35 students (stated); 9 build-week groups (stated); groups of 4; 5 sub-problems per build with 3 groups each (locked).

## Modules

M1 Foundations of AI and Data; M2 Applied Machine Learning; M3 Deep Learning and Neural Networks; M4 Natural Language Processing; M5 Generative AI Foundations; M6 Applied Generative AI; M7 Production AI for Real-World Applications; M8 Foundations of Agentic AI; M9 Advanced Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems; M10 Capstone Project.
